description: This file defines the 'Dispatcher' class and 'ProtocolSession' class, handling message dispatching, session management, and event emission for a protocol communication system within a Firefox-related project, utilizing external protocol definitions and helper modules.

classes.name: Dispatcher
classes.description: Manages protocol message dispatching, session creation/destruction, and event emission.

classes.name: ProtocolSession
classes.description: Represents a protocol communication session, handling method dispatch and event emission within a session context.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new protocol session with a generated ID.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Cleans up connection handlers and disposes of the root session.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, dispatches method calls, and manages responses or errors.

methods.name: _emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event to the connection based on session ID and event name.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the handler object for the session.

methods.name: _dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, cleaning up handlers and references.

methods.name: emitEvent
methods.description: Emits an event from the session.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a method call with parameters within the session.
